<thought>To find the template that reproduces the intramolecular Michael addition cyclization of chalcones to flavanones, I will search the template catalog using only the essential bond changes: formation of a C‑C bond (6‑6) and a C‑O bond (6‑8), and breaking of a C‑O bond (6‑8). No functional‑group filters are applied to broaden the search and capture the appropriate intramolecular cyclization template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(Cc1ccc(O)cc1)C2CC(O)C3=CC=CC=C3O2",
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
